title: About {{brand}} | Aesthetic and dental care in Cairo
description: Get to know {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, from assessment and treatment planning to aftercare, follow-up and our approach to device selection.
answer: {{brand}} is a medical aesthetic, nutrition and dental clinic with branches in New Cairo and Mohandessin, Greater Cairo. Its areas of care include skin treatments and injectables, laser, body and nutrition, and dentistry at Mohandessin. The clinic also arranges plastic surgery consultations and care with partner consultant surgeons.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: At a consultation we ask what you want to change, review your health history and assess the area of concern. You can ask about alternatives, likely recovery and the limits of treatment before deciding.
We discuss a written plan with you, including how to prepare, what to expect afterwards and when to return for follow-up. Tell the team about any concerns during recovery so they can advise you.
